fato_historico: 1981: President François Mitterrand abolishes capital punishment in France.
energia_do_dia: Today the universe encourages you to embrace the tides of mercy, Piscis. Just as a historic shift once moved a nation toward ending harsh endings, you may find it is a good time to let go of old judgments. Consider replacing rigid boundaries with a gentle, inclusive spirit, allowing your heart to bloom with true forgiveness and renewed creative depth.
frase_do_dia: True freedom begins when you release the weight of yesterday with a gentle heart.
significado_numero: A master number representing spiritual intuition and deep emotional connection.
conselho: Practice kindness toward yourself today; you deserve the same grace you offer others.
